acceptanceCriteria: A change outside the declared intents is refused the allowance, with a focused test.
body:
Source: wave-6 lane report (2026-10-11).

Observed: the dogfood bootstrap allowance is not tied to the declared intents (related docs ticket V1-0561).

Expected: the allowance applies only to the declared intents.

Acceptance: a change outside the declared intents is refused the allowance, with a focused test.
title: Tie the dogfood bootstrap allowance to the declared intents
